articles.title: Argentina Escapes Swiss Trap as Alvarez's Rocket Sends Them to Semis
articles.summary: Trailing 1-1 deep into extra time, Argentina looked headed for a penalty shootout—until Julián Alvarez unleashed a stunning strike in the 112th minute. The 3-1 win sets up a semifinal clash with England. Messi's record goal streak ended at nine games.

articles.title: Tuchel Fumes Despite England's Gritty Win: 'We Were Sloppy and Lucky'
articles.summary: England edged Norway to reach the World Cup semis, but manager Thomas Tuchel blasted the performance as 'sloppy' and full of 'technical mistakes.' Jude Bellingham's brace papered over the cracks. Tuchel demands a more deliberate, patterned attacking style.

articles.title: Zelenskyy Reshuffles Cabinet as PM Svyrydenko Steps Down Amid War Pressures
articles.summary: Ukrainian Prime Minister Yulia Svyrydenko resigned Sunday, with President Zelenskyy announcing a broader government overhaul—the fourth since Russia's full-scale invasion. Svyrydenko, 39, was offered a new role focused on a key international partner.
